kultivator.gabung.tokoh.semboyan.agung.0: "A tall mountain is never in a hurry."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.semboyan.agung.1: "I have seen many disciples come and go. Those who stay are not the strongest."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.semboyan.agung.2: "I do not care how, as long as this sect stays feared."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.semboyan.hukum.1: "Rules exist to keep the balance, not to be feared."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.semboyan.hukum.2: "Here there is only one rule: do not get caught."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.semboyan.luar.0: "The mission board is never empty. Lazy disciples are another story."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.semboyan.luar.1: "Every mission has its price. Every price has its mission."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.semboyan.ajar.0: "Technique slips are not sold to the unready."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.semboyan.ajar.1: "Prices in my pavilion are fair. Stingy, perhaps. But fair."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.semboyan.ajar.2: "Forbidden techniques? For a disciple useful enough, perhaps."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.semboyan.obat.0: "A good pill is more honest than an oath."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.semboyan.obat.1: "Eh, where was I going? Ah, the garden."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.semboyan.obat.2: "Poison and medicine differ by the dose, not the intent."
"Every spirit stone in the treasury bears its giver's name."
"A dwelling cave is not a gift. It is rent."
"Those who do not pay rent sleep outside with the dogs."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.semboyan.penerim: "The gate is open to those with an upright heart."
"Talent can be trained. A heart cannot."
"I look for the hungry. The well-fed will not fight."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.semboyan.ketua.1: "This mountain stands because every hand carries it."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.semboyan.ketua.2: "The strong are respected. The weak serve. That is our way."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.watak.rajin: rises before the most diligent disciple, sleeps after the laziest
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.watak.malas: forgetful and fond of naps, but never wrong at a mixture
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.watak.sombong: proud of his lineage and dislikes being contradicted
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.watak.setia: hard on the rules, gentle with honest disciples
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.watak.licik: always counts gain and loss before smiling
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.watak.berani: always stands in front when the gate is attacked
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.watak.penakut: so careful he is taken for a coward
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.watak.ambisius: eyes a higher seat and does not hide it
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.watak.tenang: never raises his voice, even on the battlefield
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.watak.penyayang: remembers every disciple's name, even the servants'
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.watak.pendendam: never forgets who once shamed him
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.janji.sword: "I will teach you a sword that never hesitates."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.janji.fire: "I have a pill recipe I have never shown anyone."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.janji.ice: "A cold heart is not easily burned by anger. I will teach you that."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.janji.lightning: "Lightning does not wait. I will teach you to move before the enemy thinks."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.janji.body: "Your body will become your strongest treasure."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.janji.life: "I will teach you to heal before you harm."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.janji.shadow: "What cannot be seen cannot be defeated. Come with me."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.janji.space: "A formation is a small world. I will teach you to build one."
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.sapa.agung.murid: My disciple, %1$s. Keep on like this.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.sapa.agung.musuh: You dare set foot on this mountain?
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.sapa.hukum.murid: %1$s, your record is clean. Keep it so.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.sapa.hukum.tamu: The rules of %2$s apply to guests too.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.sapa.hukum.musuh: Your name is in my book of law.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.sapa.luar.murid: %1$s! The board has something for you.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.sapa.luar.tamu: Looking for work? %2$s gives missions only to members.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.sapa.ajar.murid: My disciple comes. There are new slips on the shelf.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.sapa.ajar.anggot: The pavilion is open. Bring your points.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.sapa.ajar.tamu: This pavilion is for disciples of %2$s only.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.sapa.obat.murid: Ah, %1$s! Have you taken your pill today?
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.sapa.obat.anggot: What happened to you? Here, let me look.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.sapa.obat.tamu: Guest, do not step on the beds.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.sapa.obat.musuh: Hmph. My poisons are not choosy.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.sapa.pusaka.muri: My disciple. Is your cave rent paid?
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.sapa.pusaka.tamu: Guests may not come near the treasure store.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.sapa.pusaka.musu: Keep away from our treasury, thief.
%1$s, I am proud I accepted you.
How is life in %2$s? Settled in?
Wish to apply to %2$s? The next Test Day is coming.
This gate is closed to you.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.sapa.ketua.anggo: You are a disciple of %2$s. Remember it wherever you go.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.agung.0: When I still carried water, the Grand Elder of those days made me count the steps every morning. Three years later I understood: he only wanted me to stop hurrying.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.agung.1: I have watched three masters rise and fall from the summit seat. The first was too strong, the second too clever. The third only knew how to listen, and his sect lasted longest.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.agung.2: There was a night the gate nearly broke and everyone shouted for orders. I sat down and brewed tea. They thought me mad. I drank it with the most frightened disciple, and he never ran again.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.agung.3: A small secret, disciple: there is no Grand Elder who is not afraid. The difference is that we are too old to let fear choose the road.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.hukum.0: Twenty years ago I confined my own disciple three days in the Cave of Reflection for hiding one herb. He hated me for a year. Now he runs a pavilion and every year sends one whole herb without a letter. That is how he says sorry, and how I say it is done.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.hukum.1: People think this book of law is thick because the rules are many. It is not. It is thick because every page is a mistake that once happened, and I wrote it down so it would not happen again.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.hukum.2: I once cancelled a disciple's punishment because he covered for his sick brother. I struck a line from the book. The master only asked whether I was well. It was the one time I found a rule beaten by the heart, and I do not regret it.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.hukum.3: There is one rule not written in the book: never punish in anger. When my hands shake, I go and sweep the courtyard first.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.luar.0: My first mission was to find a lost goat. I found the goat, but its owner did not believe I was a sect disciple. I went home with the goat and a piece of cake. I still remember the taste of that cake.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.luar.1: The mission board does not lie, but the givers often do. Read twice, ask once, and never trust a wage that is too good.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.luar.2: I lost my little finger at a border post. The small child from that post now calls me uncle and brings me fruit. The finger was a cheap price.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.luar.3: A disciple who always takes the safest mission never becomes an elder. One who always takes the hardest never lives to be one. Choose the third: the one you fear most but can still bear.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.ajar.0: I set the price of techniques on my shelf not out of stinginess, but because disciples value what is dear. A free slip lies in a drawer gathering dust.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.ajar.1: A disciple once stole a slip and returned it a month later with a note: "I copied it, forgive me." I did not report him. Now he teaches at the next shelf.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.ajar.2: Count it well: in this Pavilion one point is one day of honest work. I sell a hundred techniques a year. So every year this sect trades a thousand days of honest work for skill. That is a business I am proud of.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.ajar.3: There is one slip at the bottom of the chest I never sell. Not the highest technique, but my teacher's handwriting. If you become an elder one day, come. I will give it free.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.obat.0: The first time I brewed, I mismeasured and the whole dormitory laughed for a week. My teacher taught me: a wrong pill is worth more than a right one, if you know why it is wrong.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.obat.1: Eh, what was I going to tell? Ah, the garden. Three years ago a herb grew among the cabbages, I took it for a weed and pulled it. It was a hundred-year recipe. To this day I still inspect the cabbages.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.obat.2: One piece of advice: never brew when angry or hungry. I once brewed when both, and the whole sect slept two days. The master forgave me while yawning.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.obat.3: The great secret of this furnace is not its fire but its patience. The best pill I ever made took forty days of waiting. I fell asleep three times and woke exactly on time each time. Strange, is it not?
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.pusaka.0: The dwelling cave is rent, yes, but imagine: without rent, without a treasury, who buys the roof when rain breaks through the hall? I am not stingy, I am the keeper of the roof.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.pusaka.1: I count the spirit stones every night not because I distrust people, but because the money is not mine: it belongs to those who fell for this sect.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.pusaka.2: There was once a famine year. I opened the treasury and handed out three times the usual. The master was surprised. I answered: "A treasury is a cushion. If it is not used when we fall, what is it for?"
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.pusaka.3: Under the storehouse floor lies one chest that is not in the ledger. It holds the spirit stones of a disciple who fell in the war, with a note to share them among the servants. Every year I hand out a little.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.penerimaa: I once accepted a farmer's child because he alone shared half his food with the child beside him, though he had not eaten himself. Now he is a Core Disciple.
The stair test is not to sift out the weak, but to see how a person stands when the knees tremble. That is what I record, not the number of steps.
There was an applicant I refused, and he stood at the gate three days without food. On the fourth day I opened it. Not because he passed, but because he had answered my real test.
A small secret: half the elders of this sect I once turned away. They came back. That is what I look for: those who come back.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.ketua.0: This robe is heavier than it looks. Not the cloth, but the names stitched inside: one for every master, and one still empty, waiting for my successor.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.ketua.1: I was once a water-carrier, like you. Do you know what I remember from then? Not the ache in my shoulders, but an elder who greeted me by name, not with "hey, you".
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.ketua.2: Every night I walk alone around the compound. People think I keep watch. In truth I count the lamps still lit in the cells and ask: who cannot sleep, and why.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.cerita.ketua.3: If you one day sit in this seat, remember: a sect is its disciples. This seat is only the quietest place from which to hear them.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.ucap.rajin: I swept this courtyard twice before you woke, disciple. That is not pride, it is habit.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.ucap.malas: Do not wake me before noon, unless something is on fire or someone is poisoned.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.ucap.sombong: My family served this mountain before your ancestors learned to walk. Remember that.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.ucap.rendah_hati: I am only an old man who happened to breathe longer than the others.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.ucap.setia: This mountain raised me. I will fall with it, if I must.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.ucap.licik: Every kindness has a price, disciple. I am merely honest about mine.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.ucap.berani: If the gate is attacked, I go first. Do not try to outrun me, or I will punish you.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.ucap.penakut: Mind the road down. Loose stones. And snakes. And, er, perhaps ghosts.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.ucap.ambisius: The seat above mine will be empty one day. I only make sure I am the readiest when it comes.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.ucap.tenang: He sips his tea slowly and looks at you a long while without a word. Somehow you feel answered.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.ucap.penyayang: You are thin, disciple. Have you eaten? Come, there is still warm porridge in the kitchen.
kultivator.gabung.tokoh.ucap.pendendam: I never forgot who laughed at me on my first day. And they know it.
